# Language & Cognition Laboratory (LC Lab), IIT Madras

> The Language & Cognition Laboratory is a research lab in the Department of Humanities and Social Sciences at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras), led by Dr. Anindita Sahoo. The lab studies the intersection of language, cognition, and communication using theoretical, typological, and experimental methods, with a particular focus on Indian languages.

Principal Investigator: Dr. Anindita Sahoo, Assistant Professor, Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, IIT Madras; Faculty PI at CeRAI, IIT Madras.
Research interests: Linguistic typology, syntax, pragmatics, language processing, eye-tracking, and cognition studies.

Contact: lclab@smail.iitm.ac.in | +91 44 2257 5518
Address: LC Lab, Ground Floor, HSB (behind CLT), Chennai - 600036, Tamil Nadu, India

## Research focus areas

- Language and cognition: neural and psychological mechanisms of language processing and comprehension.
- Eye-tracking analysis: pupillometry and gaze-tracking for real-time linguistic processing data.
- Cross-linguistic studies: comparative research across Indo-Aryan, Dravidian, and other language families.
- Experimental and computational methods applied to linguistic datasets, with an emphasis on Indian languages.
